Class LocatorFieldDef

Namespace
Tripous.Data
Assembly
Tripous.Data.dll

Describes the "field" (text box or grid column) of a Locator.

A field such that associates a column in the data table (the target) to a column in the list table (the source), the table returned by a Locator search.

NOTE: The inherited Name is a field name from the source table.

public class LocatorFieldDef : BaseDef, IDef, IJsonLoadable, INotifyPropertyChanged
